bullets: Own a product area end to end: Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your team’s surface, and take features from discovery through launch and iteration.
Obsess over the customer experience: Bring a strong point of view on UX and use research, behavioral data, and customer conversations to decide what to build next.
Drive conversion, engagement, and retention: Define the north stars that matter for your area, dig into the funnel, and rapidly drive outcomes for customers and for Engine.
Be AI-native: Use AI every day to move faster, from prototyping and research synthesis to writing specs, and find where AI can make the customer experience simpler and more…
Lead cross-functionally: Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Operations, and Support to turn competing priorities into a clear, shared direction.
Own Product-Led Growth: Craft and execute experimentation-driven strategies across onboarding, activation, retention loops, and monetization. You’ll move the metrics that matter…
Build AI-Powered Experiences: Collaborate with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market partners to apply LLMs, predictive logic, and smart automation that reduce friction…
Grow Every Account: Drive cross-sell and attach across hotels, flights, cars, and groups, and adoption of Direct Bill, FlexPro, and Rewards at the moment of need. Keep accounts…
Connect Product and Sales: Spot high-intent moments in the product and get those accounts to the right sales or account team fast, so self-serve and human help work as one motion.
Lead Experimentation at Scale: Form hypotheses, design and run A/B tests, and partner with data teams to turn results into action. Test early, learn fast, and scale what works…
Own your platform end to end: Shape the strategy and roadmap for your area, and take it from requirements through launch and adoption.
Define and measure success: Turn customer and partner needs into clear technical requirements, set the metrics that matter for your platform, from adoption to reliability, and use…
Lead with technical depth: Get into the details of architecture, APIs, and system tradeoffs, and find where AI can make your platform smarter or more reliable.
Balance long-term bets with near-term wins: Make hard prioritization calls between foundational platform investments and the customer and revenue outcomes the business needs now.
Partner across the business: Work with data, product, and business teams, and explain what your platform does and why it matters to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Map the work: Shadow the people doing the work and map each step, handoff and wait, so you know where the time goes.
Pick the workload: Take on one workload at a time, starting with the steps that are repetitive, high-volume and the most time-consuming. You and the functional leader decide what…
Lock the metric: Before anything gets built, get the functional leader to sign off on a cycle time or unit metric, and measure the baseline.
Build and ship: Work with engineering to design and ship automation that replaces manual work at Engine’s scale, which includes hundreds of thousands of support cases. Use AI…
Scope and roll out: Define the first version you can ship, who uses it first and how it reaches the rest of the function.
